title: EMST v2 source record
description: One EMST v2 source record (YAML-LD using the terms of schema/emst.context.jsonld), discriminated by `type`. Records are closed objects: unknown fields, and therefore every computed summary (SPEC §14.2), are rejected. Cross-record rules (references, registry, text-hash staleness, v1 completeness, Tribal hold, personal data, typing and indicator lint) are enforced by scripts/validate_v2.py, not by this schema.
$comment: GENERATED by scripts/build_schema.py from schema/src/emst.schema.src.yaml and vocab/*.yaml. Do not edit; run the script. Schema version 2.0.0-draft.4.

SeedKey.description: Throwaway draft key used until a record reaches `candidate` (ADR-0010 §2).

RecordRef.description: An EMST ID or, for drafts, a seed key.

ExternalRef.description: Registered CURIE or absolute IRI of a non-EMST concept (O*NET, ESCO, SOC, OPM, EMSTv1 legacy codes...).

License.description: SPDX licence ID (ADR-0013). LicenseRef-EMSTv1-PendingDedication marks v1-derived text until the project lead's Q2 dedication.

AgentId.description: Pseudonymous person ID (pid:...), panel ID (panel:...), software agent with version (emstagent:...), external index (index:...) or the v1 analyst (v1-analyst-01). Never a name or e-mail address (ADR-0012 I-1).

SourceId.description: Team source ID (e.g. LM-001, V4-10) resolving to a sources.csv or key-facts row, or an EMST Source record ID.

reviewBy.description: Required from candidate on when evidenceLabel is J or S (E-EDGE-REVIEWBY; ADR-0030).

InstrumentLink.description: Typed link to an L5 Instrument (CR-SC-001 #2; ADR-0030). The role is time-invariant; the instrument's dated events supply time. Only `requires` links decide venue applicability.

PublicationRuleCheck.description: Result of one publication rule at one level (SPEC §8.2; CR-IO-001 as ratified in ADR-0029 §5).

LifecycleBasis.description: The evidence and the entry test behind a lifecycle state (rc.1 fix pass, ADR-0032; review M7). Required on L1-L4 records that are proposed or emerging; also kept on records moved to watch because the test was not met. scripts/validate_v2.py recomputes `counts` from `evidence` and re-applies the vocabulary's entry_test (vocab/lifecycle_states.yaml#<testedFor>.entry_test): E-LIFECYCLE-BASIS.

testedFor.description: The state whose entry_test was applied.

evidence.description: Signals (and a mandate Instrument) the test read; may be empty.

mandate.description: Instrument with an effective event (proposed: mandate branch).

v1Key.description: Key resolving to a row of data/v1_baseline/.

adr.description: Decision reference(s), e.g. ADR-0028 or [ADR-0011, CR-DE-001].

notation.description: Aliases such as {scheme EMSTv1, value 2.1.1}. Never an ID.

lifecycleState.description: How established the WORK is in the sector (never the validation of the record; ADR-0032).

useTier.description: Declared ceiling; the effective tier is computed.

V1CompetencySeed.description: v1 content carried as reference-only seed material for authors (ADR-0011: indicators carried as draft seeds only; sector notes kept as seed illustrations). Stripped from every release artifact.

statement.description: ≤ 60 words (lint). Practice/transversal: verb + object (+ context); knowledge area: noun phrase.

levelSpanBasis.description: anchored: every level in levelSpan (other than A) has indicators in levels[]; declared: the span states where the competency applies and is not (yet) anchored by indicators, as for knowledge areas. Checked by E-LEVELSPAN-BASIS (rc.1 fix pass, ADR-0032; review m6).

enactments.description: DEPRECATED (ADR-0029 §1.2): a computed inverse of Enactment.competency (vocab/rules/inverse-links@1.1.0). Tolerated on drafts during S1 with W-COMPUTED-FIELD-DEPRECATED; rejected from candidate on; ignored by the build.

mirrors.description: Stored on the authority side only (ADR-0030; CR-SC-001 #3); the inverse mirroredBy is computed.

statement.description: One sentence, ≤ 30 words: observable verb + object + condition + standard.

obs4.description: OBS-4 observability code from human coding (double-coded by two humans for select). null until humans code it; an agent's self-code is kept in obs4Draft and is never read as obs4 (rc.1 fix pass, ADR-0032; review m8).

obs4Draft.description: An agent self-code of OBS-4, kept as draft evidence for the human coders; never an input to a tier or a view.

distinguishingAttribute.description: Attribute on which this indicator differs from the adjacent lower level (SPEC §8.2 PR-2; ADR-0029 §5). Required at candidate above the lowest level with indicators (E-PR2-ATTRIBUTE).

subsectors.description: Module enactments from candidate on (E-MODULE-SUBSECTOR; CR-DB-001 #4).

delegatedConstraints.description: Constraints a delegating principal places on the enacted work (CR-SC-001 #5).

statement.description: One imperative verb + object + condition or purpose; 8–30 words; no product names.

textSha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalized en statement; validate_v2 recomputes it.

emstRelease.description: Release whose competencies and CLOs the pathway cites; required from candidate on (CR-LC-001 #2).

recommended.description: MUST be false until the pathway passes the M-03 validation gate (ADR-0023).

RatingBase.description: Fields shared by every per-rater atomic judgment (SPEC §5.12–§5.13; ADR-0008 §1).

raterId.description: One rater per model and prompt family: repeated passes of one model with one prompt family share one raterId (emstagent:llm-rater@<model>/<prompt family>) and are told apart by passIndex and sessionId (rc.1 fix pass, ADR-0032; review M4). They are run-to-run consistency of one model, not independent raters.

passIndex.description: Pass number of a repeated LLM coding (1-3 in rc.1).

sessionId.description: Label of the model session (batch) that produced the pass.

sampleFrame.description: How the rated units were chosen, e.g. selected on the outcome (ADR-0032; review M8).

assessedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD; external-index records may give YYYY or YYYY-MM (CR-LM-002; ADR-0029 §9).

v1Values.description: The v1 codes exactly as recorded (snake_case v1 column names). Prior evidence only (ADR-0008 §5).

stale.description: Computed in release bundles (assessment-staleness): the rated text no longer matches the subject. Never stored in a source record (review M8).

taskTextSha256.description: Hash of the exact statement rated; a mismatch with the task's textSha256 marks the assessment stale.

targetType.description: Occupation-grain external-index records only: RoleProfile or RoleVariant.

levelDistribution.description: Shares of E0-E3 summing to 1 ± 0.01 (validator E-LEVEL-DISTRIBUTION).

sWatch.description: XR-04 watch flag; any rater type (ADR-0029 §1.5).

values.description: The index's own published numbers for the matched unit(s).

competency.description: v1-analyst records only: v1 tagged crafts per competency.

object.description: Role profile or variant; for v1-analyst records a legacy EMSTv1 reference (family, reform flags, ethical lens, CLD tag).

independenceKey.description: Upstream-provider key: an enumeration generated from vocab/change_types.yaml#independence_keys (unlisted keys are rejected at every status; the validator also reports E-INDEPENDENCE-KEY-UNLISTED; ADR-0032, review M5).

upstreamSource.description: The primary upstream dataset or document the value comes from (the same ID for every reading of one dataset, whatever document `source` cites). ER-1 requires disjoint upstreamSource (ADR-0032; review M5).

processingChain.description: Judgment-bearing steps between the upstream source and the value (vocab/change_types.yaml#processing_chain_steps); ER-1 requires disjoint chains (ADR-0032; review M5).

observationId.description: One observation attached to several targets shares one observationId; counts report distinct observations (vocab/change_types.yaml#observations; ADR-0032; review M5).

difference.description: The observed-minus-comparison difference and its interval; direction must be indeterminate when ci95, or the sensitivity ci95, includes 0 (E-DIRECTION-INDETERMINATE; ADR-0032; review M6).

nullReason.description: Why a Required measure field (SPEC §5.14) is null: ci95 or n (E-MEASURE-NULL-REASON; ADR-0032; review M5).

sha256.description: null only when no corpus snapshot exists (single published document)

novelty.description: No L0 vocabulary yet; FS/LM score or label.

sourceGrade.description: Admiralty-style grade (A-D) of the source, renamed from `reliability` (ADR-0032; review m9). Not a statistical reliability.

corroboration.description: Number of independent corroborating signal families.

signalStatus.description: SPEC §5.14 `status`, renamed to avoid the editorial-status field (ADR-0029 §1).

actingInstrument.description: The instrument whose issuance produced this event (e.g. a revoking order); never the event's own instrument (E-ACTING-SELF).

Mapping.description: One SSSOM 1.0 mapping row as rendered in JSON-LD bundles (canonical store is SSSOM/TSV, SPEC §15).

AgentDraftCompetencyTarget.description: Agent-drafted values of a RoleProfile.competencyTargets[] that the display gate does not render, moved here in the release bundle (rc.1 fix pass M1; scripts/agent_draft.py). Never present in a source record.

AgentDraftIndicator.description: Agent-drafted values of a Indicator that the display gate does not render, moved here in the release bundle (rc.1 fix pass M1; scripts/agent_draft.py). Never present in a source record.

obs4.description: OBS-4 observability code from human coding (double-coded by two humans for select). null until humans code it; an agent's self-code is kept in obs4Draft and is never read as obs4 (rc.1 fix pass, ADR-0032; review m8).

obs4Draft.description: An agent self-code of OBS-4, kept as draft evidence for the human coders; never an input to a tier or a view.

AgentDraftTask.description: Agent-drafted values of a Task that the display gate does not render, moved here in the release bundle (rc.1 fix pass M1; scripts/agent_draft.py). Never present in a source record.

AgentDraftTaskBundleItem.description: Agent-drafted values of a RoleProfile.taskBundle[] that the display gate does not render, moved here in the release bundle (rc.1 fix pass M1; scripts/agent_draft.py). Never present in a source record.

CompetencyLevelOutcome.description: Computed competency or enactment level outcome (CR-LC-001 #3; SPEC §12.3): derived IRI, never minted.

EmstId.description: Persistent EMST ID (ADR-0010): emst:<namespace>/<TYPE>-<6 Crockford base32><Luhn mod-32 check>. The check symbol is verified by scripts/validate_v2.py.

Release.description: The release manifest node of a JSON-LD bundle (computed by scripts/build_release.py; never a source record).

jurisdictionId.description: Government unit that owns the class [MUST; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

levelIndex.description: Ordinal level in series plus native label [MUST; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

supervisoryStatus.description: Supervisory level of the class: non-supervisory, lead, supervisor, manager or executive (e.g. TX: supervision normally at IV-V; NY M-grades). Machine values per CR-DE-002 #4. [MUST; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

specEffectiveDate.description: Date the spec text took effect [MUST; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

workDescriptionText.description: Definition, distinguishing characteristics, examples of work [MUST; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

mqText.description: Minimum or desirable qualifications, verbatim [MUST; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

licensesRequired.description: Licenses or registrations with issuer and timing [MUST; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

payGradeLabel.description: Native grade or range label [SHOULD; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

bargainingUnit.description: Representation unit and shadow-class flag [SHOULD; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

appointmentRoute.description: How people enter the class: open-competitive-exam; continuous-t-and-e (continuous training-and-experience evaluation); application-as-exam; non-competitive (e.g. NY HELPS); provisional; transfer-list; performance-based (e.g. LEAP). Machine values per CR-DE-002 #4; a class may have several. [SHOULD; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

relatedTitles.description: Native lateral, transfer and promotion links [SHOULD; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

socCode.description: SOC 2018 occupation code assigned by the employer [SHOULD; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

federalEquivalent.description: Equivalent OPM series and grade band [MAY; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]

emstMapping.description: Target role variant, mapped role level(s), match type, confidence, reviewer, review date; competency targets with level are computed by the State Class View from the role and are never stored here (CR-FH-001 [MUST; vocab/state_class_fields.yaml]
